chapter: Drum sets, small bands and the depression
title: Cowbells and temple blocks, then and now
summary: Old drummers had three or four tuned cowbells mounted on the drum; today's use one, more modernistically.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Your old drum set, did you have cowbells too? Ever used those? I had cowbells, I got cowbells now. You still use them? Yeah, still use them. But you use them in a different way than you did at that time.
They had cowbells, the temple blocks on the top of the drum. Where are those temples? I use them.
You use them different now than you used to use them then? What was it different?

Yeah, well they're different in cowbells now. You use them more modernistic. Even when you're playing Dixieland, you don't beat them as much as you used to do. Sometimes guys just take two sticks, you know, just take two sticks and stay on a cowbell. Maybe all through a number, all through a curve. Get off one cowbell and on it to another. But now, he doesn't do that anymore. He might take and play a little rhythm, a Dixieland rhythm on one cowbell. And he might not use other cowbell all night. See, from that time he used both of them. But now, the average drummer you see now, whether he's playing Dixieland or modern drum, he ain't got, he don't have but one cowbell. You notice the drum was only one cowbell.
And how many did you used to have?
Oh, you had from three to four of them.
And it'd be tuned a little different?
Yeah, tuned a little different. See, and it was mounted on top of your drum.
Galbeth Jow has a scent like that. Yeah, yeah.
Yeah, yeah. One of the few that has them.
Did they used to sell those bells in the stores?
They used to sell them in the music store, yeah. Music store, you'd get them in the music store.
I don't remember seeing any lately.
No, don't see any lately, but you'd get them in the music store.
You don't know what company made them?
No, I never didn't know where company made them. I never didn't know where we made them. But you could get them in the store. I don't know.
